# ExcelInsight

> ExcelInsight is a free, browser-based tool that converts Excel and CSV spreadsheets into interactive charts, statistics, and dashboards — entirely in your browser, with no file upload, no account, and no data leaving your device.

ExcelInsight runs 100% client-side using JavaScript. When you open the app and drop a spreadsheet, the file is read by your browser directly; it is never sent to a server. The tool works on any modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. No installation is required.

## Quick Facts

**Is ExcelInsight free?**
Yes. There are no plans, no subscriptions, and no usage limits. The entire tool is free.

**Is my data private?**
Yes. Your file is processed locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server. ExcelInsight has no backend that receives file content.

**What file formats does it support?**
ExcelInsight supports .xlsx, .xls, and .csv files. Files exported from Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Apple Numbers, or any database or accounting tool will work.

**How large a file can I analyze?**
Files with up to ~100,000 rows typically run smoothly on a modern laptop. Performance depends on the user's device since all processing happens client-side.

**Does it require a signup or account?**
No. There is no login, no registration, and no email required.

**Does it work offline?**
After the initial page load, most functionality continues to work without an internet connection because everything runs client-side.

## Capabilities

- **Auto-generated charts**: Bar, line, pie, area, scatter, radar, and horizontal bar charts — automatically suggested based on column types and data distributions.
- **Custom dashboard**: Drag, drop, and resize chart cards to build a personalized layout.
- **Smart insights**: Automatic detection of column statistics (min, max, mean, median, std dev), repeating values, outliers, and data quality scores.
- **Column merging**: Combine two columns into a new derived field with a custom separator.
- **Data filtering**: Filter rows by value across any column; every chart and insight updates live.
- **PDF export**: Export the full dashboard (charts, tables, insights) as a single PDF report.
- **PNG export**: Export individual charts as high-resolution PNG images.
- **Multi-language UI**: English, Hindi, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, French, German.
